Phase 0 \u2014 Discovery and expert labe.why: Scope, data access, and 300 complaints labelled by two of the firm's own handlers. Unchanged from Round 1: labelling is triage-specific, discovery covers all three.

Phase 1 \u2014 Pilot build and 60-day sh.why: All three capabilities on the shared spine, running alongside the existing process. Round 1 costed 12 days for triage alone.

Phase 2 \u2014 Deployment, if the pilot.why: Case-system integration, handler and analyst training, monitoring handover. Round 1 costed 15 days for one capability.

break_even_volume.note: At this client's volume the bespoke build does not pay back inside 36 months. This is the volume at which it would.

productised.note: The build is bespoke today. Amortising it across five mid-size firms is what turns the same capability from a loss into a return for a client this size. It is a commercial decision, not a technical one.

report_days_per_quarter_now.basis: person-days assembling the quarterly complaints report by hand

report_time_reduction_pct.basis: share of drafting time displaced; the review still happens in full

fraud_unauth_share_pct.basis: share of the reference corpus that is fraud or unauthorised transactions (810 + 437 of 16,839)

earlier_detection_rate_pct.basis: share of those cases caught by monitoring before the customer complains. THE SOFTEST NUMBER IN THIS MODEL

avoided_ombudsman_cases.basis: escalations avoided per year by routing correctly first time. Explicitly NOT claimed as a benefit today; the pilot exists to test it

ombudsman_case_fee_gbp.basis: Financial Ombudsman Service case fee, frozen for 2025/26

review_days_per_quarter.basis: quarterly review of three capabilities rather than one. Round 1 assumed 2 for a single capability; this is the cost of the widened scope

reports_per_year.basis: one complaints report per quarter, 4 sections each

anomaly_candidates_per_batch.basis: candidates in ONE capped monthly review batch. The 56 was raised by the detector on the 40-account, 90-day synthetic fixture, so it sizes a bounded analyst queue rather than the client's transaction book. detect() applies no cap, so at the same 2.71% flag rate the full book would raise ~154,000 a month. UC-2 is costed as a reviewed batch on purpose; the unbounded version is R9, and it is arithmetic, not a worry

report_tokens_in.basis: sized from the prompt in mvp/capabilities/reporting.py, not counted from an API response. Measured across all four sections 2026-09-03: 408 in / 144 out mean. The costed figure is deliberately left at the higher estimate

anomaly_tokens_in.basis: sized from the prompt in mvp/capabilities/anomaly.py, not counted from an API response. Measured over six candidates 2026-09-03: 314 in / 94 out mean. The costed figure is deliberately left at the higher estimate

usd_eur.basis: rounded mid-market rate, stated rather than hidden

value_starts_month.basis: Phase 0 + 1 + 2 run about six months end to end, so benefits accrue from month 7. This is why the 12-month ROI is negative and the 36-month is not
